column1: # RERUN_PARTS_release_N.tsv: the 37 parts in which rerun_m2.py checked release_N. Each part ran as python3 -I -B rerun_m2.py --runs <runs> from the root of a fresh copy of the package, except parts 35 and 36, which ran on the copy that the parts before them left (the three strip_ne parts, in level order on one copy). cpu_s: user plus system seconds of the part on one core. Columns: part, family, copy, runs, cpu_s
